text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Happy holidays, Trainer-sama~ While the 
Mejiro family party is simply wonderful 
too~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I would like to celebrate with someone 
else this year. It's a heartwarming little 
social gathering~

Honoring Mejiro Bright's wishes, we 
decided to celebrate with the three of us 
from the same generation.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Bright-san, Trainer-san! Thank you so much 
for inviting me to this fated Christmas 
party!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Bright... today is when we're doing the 
gift exchange, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. Heartfelt gifts for everyone~. I am 
sure it will be delightful~.

And so, they exchanged presents. First, 
Silence Suzuka to Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fukukitaru... Here, take this.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, what could this be? It appears to be 
placed intentionally in something 
resembling a convenience store plastic 
bag?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Just stuff I bought at the convenience 
store. Gum, a charger... and salt and 
pepper."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Salt and pepper!? Why on earth?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, it feels like it might ward off evil 
spirits, so don't mind if I do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Next up is my gift for Suzuka-sama, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have prepared a hair barrette for you, 
Lady Suzuka. It will suit your lovely hair 
perfectly~.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, I'll have some. Though as for 
Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes...? Is there something for me?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm always on the receiving 
end. Getting so many irreplaceable things 
from you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Suzuka... Ehehe, the pleasure is all 
mine~

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And last of all, it's my turn to give 
Bright-san a present. My gift to you is 
none other than—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: That's a secret!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Howaa... A secret. What is a 'secret'~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, basically, it's a secret. We're 
still preparing it, so I can't reveal 
anything just yet, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It will surely become clear before the 
year is out! Please look forward to it!

...It seems they've prepared something 
big. I suppose I should look forward to 
it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whew, that was so much fun— Christmas with 
the four of us♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I could really feel the deep connection we 
share as classmates!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It's different from spending time 
with anyone else. So many memories...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, since we're here, let's make a 
wish upon the stars to finish up~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"May we walk together happily ever 
after~."

Silence Suzuka closes her eyes, Mejiro 
Bright puts her hands together in prayer, 
and Matikanefukukitaru claps her hands 
twice.

The prayers of the three intertwined— and 
melted into the holy Christmas night sky.

And so, after parting ways with the two of 
them—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Actually, I would like to hear 
from you as well~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping I might receive a present 
myself. Would that be quite all right~?
choice_data_list: Sorry, I didn't prepare anything, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's quite all right. What you already 
have is more than enough~.

"I really don't have anything substantial 
to give. Is there anything I could offer?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, what I truly wish to receive is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It is about what lies ahead for you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, for the sake of the Mejiro family, I 
would love it if you could share your 
future with me, Trainer~.

Even with a gentle smile on her face, 
Mejiro Bright's eyes held a hint of 
seriousness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps this might sound like mere 
selfishness... just me begging for what I 
want. Even so..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is not quite it. This is... the will 
of the Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro needs you~. So that we may continue 
to shine brightly into the future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. My older sisters always say that a 
family does not prosper solely by its own 
efforts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"We need encounters. Encounters with those 
who bring new ideas and new philosophies."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The one waiting for you... was not myself, 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro has been waiting. For a long, long 
time.

Mejiro Bright's voice sounds like the 
voice of something much greater.

Looking overhead... a river piercing 
through the ages indeed flowed above.
